title: Applications for New Awards; Fund for the Improvement of Postsecondary Education-Special Projects (FIPSE-SP)
abstract: The Department of Education (Department) is issuing a notice inviting applications for new awards for fiscal year (FY) 2025 for the Fund for the Improvement of Postsecondary Education Special Projects, Assistance Listing Number 84.116J. This notice relates to the approved information collection under OMB control number 1894-0006.
